categories.main_business_segments: The company's primary business is the research, development, production, and sales of ultra-fine microfiber synthetic leather (超细纤维合成革). Main products include ultra-fine microfiber suede leather, ultra-fine microfiber glossy leather, and ultra-fine microfiber base cloth. These products are widely applied in shoe materials, sofa home furnishings, electronic products, sports equipment, engineering decoration, automotive interiors, handbags and luggage, and apparel sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes island-type ultra-fine microfiber technology as its core production method. Key technologies include PA6/PE co-blended island-type ultra-fine fiber and artificial suede production, water-based polyurethane ultra-fine fiber synthetic leather, water-reduced ultra-fine fiber synthetic leather, and recycled material-based ultra-fine fiber synthetic leather. The company holds 13 invention patents and 12 utility model patents, and has participated in drafting 28 national and industry standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major international and domestic brands including LV, CLARKS, UA, ZARA, ECCO, COLOMBO, SHIMANO, Baili, Anta, 361°, Aokang, Red Dragonfly, KUBOTA SLUGGER, Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Volkswagen, Hyundai, Geely, and Aiqi. Primary end markets include footwear, protective equipment, luggage, furniture, automotive interiors, and sports equipment. The company operates in both domestic and international markets, with 2023 exports accounting for 37.81% of total revenue.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Changyi City, Shandong Province, China. Major operating regions include East China (39.79% of 2023 revenue), South China (19.83%), and international markets (37.81%). The company has established itself as a leading supplier in the ultra-fine microfiber synthetic leather industry across China and maintains significant export operations to Europe, America, and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the synthetic leather supply chain. It sources raw materials (primarily polyurethane and polyamide fibers) from upstream suppliers, manufactures ultra-fine microfiber synthetic leather products, and sells directly to footwear manufacturers, furniture makers, automotive suppliers, and other end-product manufacturers. The company maintains both direct sales (63.33% of 2023 revenue) and distribution channels (36.67%).
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and environmental sustainability. Key R&D initiatives include developing high-performance protective labor materials with night-glow effects, low-carbon footprint bio-based ultra-fine fiber synthetic leather, zero-solvent water-based polyurethane products, and heat-resistant anti-yellowing nylon suede leather for automotive and outdoor applications. The company invested 4.05% of 2023 revenue in R&D and maintains 90 R&D personnel (16.79% of workforce).
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of ultra-fine microfiber synthetic leather products to manufacturers and through distribution channels. Revenue is recognized when customers take control of products (upon receipt confirmation for domestic sales, upon export customs clearance for international sales). Secondary revenue sources include rental income from investment properties and sales of raw materials, which represented 9.13% of 2023 total revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as one of China's largest ultra-fine microfiber synthetic leather manufacturers and is recognized as the 'China Ultra-Fiber Industry Base.' It holds a leading market position with superior product quality and technical capabilities. The company has received numerous honors including National Single Champion Demonstration Enterprise status, Chinese Famous Brand, and Chinese Well-Known Trademark. Competitive advantages include advanced technology, comprehensive product portfolio, strong brand reputation, and established relationships with major international brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company generated 329.2 million yuan in revenue in 2023, down 29.1% from 464.4 million yuan in 2022, reflecting market demand weakness. Net loss was 7.9 million yuan in 2023 compared to net profit of 11.4 million yuan in 2022. Total assets were 668.5 million yuan at year-end 2023. The company has experienced revenue decline due to international market volatility and weak downstream customer demand, though it maintains a solid asset base and positive operating cash flow of 33.2 million yuan in 2023.
